dedupe_keys.name: a large scale dataset of ifc compliant building models

description: A Large-Scale Dataset of IFC-Compliant Building Models is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors ziya hosseynzadeh, Abdolahifar Koosha (Iran University of Science and Technology). This repository contains a large-scale, open-access dataset of 73,303 complete, IFC4-compliant 3D residential building models. The dataset was computationally generated using a deterministic, rule-based algorithmic pipeline (via IfcOpenShell in Python). Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support building-stock, asset and facility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
